headlines.title: 三井住友DS清仓法国国债 转投德债和短期日债

headlines.title_en: Sumitomo Mitsui DS clears out French government bonds, shifts to German bonds and short-term Japanese debt
headlines.summary_en: Sumitomo Mitsui DS Asset Management has sold all of its French government bonds on concerns over France's fiscal situation, shifting the funds into German government bonds and short-term Japanese government bonds. Eurozone government bond risk premiums rose sharply on Thursday, indicating that market concerns over France's fiscal and political situation are beginning to spread to other markets. Meanwhile, US Treasuries and German bunds rose, while the spread between French and Italian government bonds surged. Shinji Kunibe, chief portfolio manager of the global fixed income team at Sumitomo Mitsui DS Asset Management, said: "French government bonds previously offered relatively attractive carry, but given recent developments, we have sold our entire position. We have mainly shifted these funds into German government bonds, with some also going into short-term Japanese government bonds." Trump: Strikes on Iran may escalate after the midterm elections; the Fed's continuous rate hikes are "very bad." headlines.title_en: China makes joint statement at UN Third Committee, urges curbing unilateral coercive measures
headlines.summary_en: Fu Cong, China's Permanent Representative to the United Nations, delivered a joint statement on behalf of 28 like-minded countries on unilateral coercive measures at the Third Committee of the UN General Assembly on the 1st, urging the international community to resolutely stop this illegal practice. Fu Cong said that although the international community has repeatedly called for the immediate lifting of unilateral coercive measures, these illegal measures continue to cause serious consequences, even life-threatening ones, for target countries and their people. Unilateral coercive measures, along with secondary sanctions and over-compliance, have exacerbated current humanitarian and economic challenges and seriously threatened food, energy and financial security. The growing use of tariffs as a tool of unilateral coercion, including unilateral determinations made under domestic law and additional tariffs imposed under the pretext of national security or human rights, has further politicized economic and trade issues, undermined the multilateral trading system, disrupted global industrial and supply chains, and hindered the efforts of relevant countries to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals. headlines.title: China’s R&D spending hits record 2.8% of GDP, beating OECD average for the first time
headlines.summary:
For the first time, China’s spending on research and development as a share of gross domestic product has surpassed the average for Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) members – a trend one analyst expects to continue as Beijing seeks to strengthen technological self-reliance amid intensifying global competition.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology to step up protection and utilization of industrial heritage resources
headlines.summary_en: Gao Dongsheng, chief economist of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, said recently at the 2026 Industrial Culture Development Conference held in Shanghai that developing industrial culture and promoting cultural empowerment are important measures for advancing new industrialization and developing advanced manufacturing. In the future, efforts will be stepped up to protect and utilize industrial heritage resources, build a high-quality industrial heritage protection system, establish a national industrial heritage archive database, and push industrial culture toward new frontiers and deeper development. Gao Dongsheng said that next, cultural empowerment will be integrated throughout every link and the entire chain of manufacturing, and the industrial design industry will be vigorously developed; effective mechanisms for the integrated development of culture, technology and industry will be further explored, more new scenarios for ideological and political practice, science popularization education and cultural tourism consumption will be created, a digital project for industrial culture will be implemented, and the application of new technologies such as 5G, BeiDou, virtual reality and artificial intelligence will be deepened; a project to shape and communicate China's industrial image in the new era will be implemented, and support and encouragement will be given to film and television works and other content on industrial themes,

headlines.title_en: In the first half of this year, foreign direct investment of an equity nature rose 55% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: The State Administration of Foreign Exchange's "2026 First Half China International Balance of Payments Report" shows that in the first half of 2026, foreign equity direct investment was $63.8 billion, up 55% year-on-year. The report shows that within foreign equity direct investment, net capital contributions reflecting long-term investment willingness increased by $43.1 billion; reinvested earnings of foreign-invested enterprises within China rose 31% year-on-year, indicating that foreign-invested enterprises are using more of their operating income for investment and business development in China.

headlines.title: 高盛将宁德时代和正力新能列为中国电池行业重点标的
headlines.summary: 高盛将宁德时代和正力新能列为中国电池行业重点标的，并认为随着电动车和储能需求持续增长，行业份额将进一步向具备规模、技术和成本优势的企业集中。其中，宁德时代继续被列为行业首选。高盛认为，公司动力电池业务盈利基础稳固，未来更重要的增量将来自储能及综合能源解决方案；随着业务从单纯销售电芯向系统集成和服务延伸，单项目价值量和利润率有望提升。该行给予宁德时代H股12个月目标价947港元、A股目标价565元。对于正力新能，高盛看好其通过客户扩张、产能利用率提升和储能业务发展继续获取市场份额，并预计其未来EBITDA增速可能位居所覆盖电池企业前列。高盛维持其“买入”评

headlines.title_en: Goldman Sachs names CATL and Zenergy as key picks in China's battery sector
headlines.summary_en: Goldman Sachs named CATL and Zhengli New Energy as key picks in China's battery sector, and believes that with continued growth in EV and energy storage demand, industry share will further concentrate among companies with advantages in scale, technology and cost. Among them, CATL continues to be named the sector's top pick. Goldman Sachs believes the company's power battery business has a solid profit foundation, and that the more important incremental growth in the future will come from energy storage and integrated energy solutions; as the business extends from simply selling battery cells to system integration and services, per-project value and profit margins are expected to rise. The bank gave CATL's H-shares a 12-month target price of HK$947 and A-shares a target price of RMB 565. For Zhengli New Energy, Goldman Sachs is optimistic that it will continue to gain market share through customer expansion, higher capacity utilization and development of its energy storage business, and expects its future EBITDA growth may rank among the top of the battery companies it covers. Goldman Sachs maintained its "Buy" rating

headlines.title_en: A-share private placements raise over RMB 460 billion this year, institutions actively participate
headlines.summary_en: According to Economic Daily, A-share private placements maintained an active trend in 2026. Data shows that, based on the listing date of privately placed shares, as of September 29, 157 A-share companies had implemented 175 private placements during the year, up 48.31% year-on-year; actual funds raised amounted to RMB 465.489 billion, down 39.79% year-on-year. It is worth noting that the year-on-year decline in funds raised in the private placement market this year is not due to a cooling market, but rather due to a high base in the same period last year. Last year alone, four capital replenishment private placements by Bank of China, Postal Savings Bank of China, Bank of Communications and China Construction Bank raised a combined RMB 520 billion, accounting for 70% of fundraising in that period. Overall, since the start of this year, the private placement market has been active, with institutional investors enthusiastically participating. From the perspective of the purpose of private placements, the scale of private placements used for supporting financing in major asset restructurings was relatively high. headlines.title: 超1200亿元！公募“红包”派发进行时
headlines.summary: 公募基金年内分红超1200亿元，债券型基金贡献逾六成，多只宽基ETF分红金额居前。与此同时，权益基金分红次数同比增加近八成，31家公募机构旗下产品分红金额超过10亿元。业内人士表示，在市场波动背景下，基金分红可以兑现部分收益，既有助于提升产品吸引力，也能在一定程度上帮助投资者锁定收益、缓解持仓压力。（上海证券报）

headlines.title_en: Over RMB 120 billion! Public fund "red envelopes" being distributed
headlines.summary_en: Public funds distributed more than RMB 120 billion in dividends during the year, with bond funds contributing more than 60%, and several broad-based ETFs ranking high in dividend amounts. At the same time, the number of dividend distributions by equity funds increased by nearly 80% year-on-year, and products under 31 public fund institutions paid dividends exceeding RMB 1 billion. Industry insiders said that amid market volatility, fund dividends can realize part of the returns, which helps enhance product appeal and can also, to a certain extent, help investors lock in returns and ease pressure on holdings. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 华泰证券：AI链放量推动韩国出口继续攀升
headlines.summary: 华泰证券研报指出，AI链高景气和季末出货共同推动韩国9月出口同比攀至83.5%，较8月的68.7%提高14.8个百分点；日均出口同比增长104.7%。其中，狭义AI链（半导体和计算机）贡献了约九成的出口增长，非AI链出口也较8月有所修复。出口强势推动韩国三季度贸易顺差达1153亿美元、对名义GDP增长的贡献约19.6个百分点。展望四季度，全球制造业动能偏强叠加AI链需求仍有望支撑韩国出口高增，但随着同比基数逐月抬升、存储价格环比涨幅收窄，韩国出口增速进一步上行的空间或受限。

headlines.title_en: Huatai Securities: AI chain volume growth drives continued rise in South Korea's exports
headlines.summary_en: A Huatai Securities research report pointed out that the high prosperity of the AI chain and quarter-end shipments jointly pushed South Korea's September exports up 83.5% year-on-year, 14.8 percentage points higher than August's 68.7%; average daily exports rose 104.7% year-on-year. Among them, the narrow AI chain (semiconductors and computers) contributed about 90% of export growth, while non-AI chain exports also recovered somewhat from August. Strong exports pushed South Korea's third-quarter trade surplus to $115.3 billion, contributing about 19.6 percentage points to nominal GDP growth. Looking ahead to the fourth quarter, strong global manufacturing momentum combined with AI chain demand is still expected to support high growth in South Korean exports, but as the year-on-year base rises month by month and the month-on-month increase in memory prices narrows, the room for further acceleration in South Korea's export growth may be limited.

headlines.title: 日本经济财政大臣城内实：希望日本央行在政策引导方面继续与政府保持密切沟通
headlines.summary: 日本经济财政大臣城内实：希望日本央行在政策引导方面继续与政府保持密切沟通。 鉴于日本央行决定结束收益率曲线控制，日本已不再需要实施非常规货币刺激措施。 日本已不再处于通缩状态，因此无需采取过度宽松、推高通胀的货币政策。 高市政府的政策不同于旨在使日本摆脱通缩的再通胀政策。 高市政府的政策不同于安倍经济学，力求同时实现强劲经济和财政纪律，侧重提升日本的供给能力。

headlines.title_en: Japan's Economic and Fiscal Policy Minister Minoru Kiuchi: hopes BOJ will continue to maintain close communication with the government on policy guidance
headlines.summary_en: Japan's Minister of State for Economic and Fiscal Policy Minoru Kiuchi: He hopes the Bank of Japan will continue to maintain close communication with the government in policy guidance. Given the Bank of Japan's decision to end yield curve control, Japan no longer needs to implement unconventional monetary stimulus measures. Japan is no longer in deflation, so there is no need for excessively accommodative monetary policy that pushes up inflation. The Takaichi government's policy is different from reflationary policies aimed at pulling Japan out of deflation. The Takaichi government's policy is different from Abenomics, seeking to achieve both a strong economy and fiscal discipline, with a focus on enhancing Japan's supply capacity.

headlines.title: 高盛：美国若禁止柴油出口 拉美地区受冲击最大
headlines.summary: 高盛周五表示，如果美国禁止柴油出口，拉丁美洲将是受影响最严重的地区。报告表示，厄瓜多尔、智利、墨西哥和秘鲁从美国进口的柴油占各自柴油消费量的50%以上。如果美国柴油供应突然中断，可能导致拉丁美洲GDP下降约1%，不过库存缓冲以及世界其他地区增加出口将减轻这一影响。高盛补充称：“鉴于柴油市场具有全球性，供应可能会迅速调整，因此实际上对全球经济的主要影响将来自柴油价格上涨。”高盛估计，美国每实施一周柴油出口禁令，美国零售柴油价格将下降每加仑0.25美元，实施一个月后，美国整体通胀率将受到温和拖累，降幅约为2-3个基点。

headlines.title_en: Goldman Sachs: If the US bans diesel exports, Latin America would be hit hardest
headlines.summary_en: Goldman Sachs said on Friday that if the United States bans diesel exports, Latin America would be the most severely affected region. The report said Ecuador, Chile, Mexico and Peru import more than 50% of their diesel consumption from the United States. A sudden disruption in US diesel supply could cause Latin American GDP to fall by about 1%, although inventory buffers and increased exports from other parts of the world would mitigate this impact. Goldman Sachs added: "Given that the diesel market is global, supply may adjust quickly, so in practice the main impact on the global economy would come from higher diesel prices." Goldman Sachs estimates that for every week a US diesel export ban is implemented, US retail diesel prices would fall by $0.25 per gallon, and after one month of implementation, overall US inflation would be mildly dragged down by about 2-3 basis points.
